response.overview: Band of Brothers is set in Chennaipara, a misty forest village near Peerumedu. Decades ago, a gunmaker from Bihar entrusted a vast arsenal he had made to Mathew, a quiet man from Peerumedu, on one condition: it must never reach the wrong hands. A Colombian family came looking for it and waited years. When Mathew refused them, they hired Vincent, an American killer with a strange method. He asks his target one question about the thing they love most, and the answer decides their fate.  Fifteen years later, Vincent comes back. The film is about what he finds there.  On the surface it’s a crime story. At heart it’s a slow, quiet film about what people become while chasing something they never find.
response.title: Band of Brothers
